sentences.text: Lonchidionoides possessed a heterodont set of teeth, with tricuspid front teeth, larger crushing teeth at the back, and intermediate forms in between.
Its generic name alludes to a resemblance with the teeth of the earlier genus Lonchidion.
The species name trifurcatum refers to the three-pronged shape of the anterior teeth.
The taxon was formally named by Vullo and colleagues in 2026.
Romain Vullo’s team described Lonchidionoides trifurcatum that year based on five teeth recovered from Algeria’s Tiout Formation.
Nine isolated teeth from Brazil were initially described as ?Lonchidiidae in 2021 and remain as Lonchidionoides sp. pending further material.
The description appeared in Geological Magazine in 2026.
The genus is interpreted as a non-marine hybodontiform, suggesting a broad ancestral range that was later divided by the opening of the South Atlantic.
Lonchidionoides is placed within the extinct hybodont family Lonchidiidae.
Lonchidionoides trifurcatum is known from the latest Albian–early Cenomanian Tiout Formation of Algeria.
Teeth attributed to the genus have also been recovered from Brazil’s Barremian–Aptian Quiricó Formation.
